{{Top}}
{{Image}}
A '''clone trooper officer''' or '''clone officer'''<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> referred to a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served as an [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Those serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] were known as [[Clone navigation officer/Legends|clone naval officers]].
